# AGENTS.md — mis-frontend

<!-- Generated by mis-workspace ONBOARDING.md from the repo profile. This is now the repo's own contract, so maintain it here. -->

## Purpose

Vue 3 + Vite admin SPA for MIS (RFID attendance and student tracking). It talks to mis-backend over REST at `VITE_API_URL` (`http://localhost:8000/api/mis`) and receives realtime RFID card scans through Laravel Echo + pusher-js. Auth (login, guard, logout for admin/registrar/cashier) is in place (mis-1), the Ledger admin shell with a role-filtered menu and placeholder pages (mis-2), school years with an active-year badge (mis-3), and the students page with search, level filter, pagination and add/edit/delete (mis-4), and the employees page (staff accounts: search, role/status filters, add/edit, reset password, deactivate/reactivate) (mis-5), and the programs setup page (SHS strands and college courses: search, stage/status filters, add/edit, deactivate/reactivate, delete) plus a grade-levels service call (mis-10), and terms per school year (term type on the school-year form, a Terms modal with add/edit/delete/set active, the active term in the top-bar badge) (mis-11), and the sections setup page (sections per school year: school year/grade level/program filters, name search, add/edit with a stage-aware program select, delete) (mis-12), and the enrollment page (enroll a student into a section, move, drop/transfer/complete; the Students page shows the current section) (mis-13), and term rollover / complete section on the enrollment page (mis-14), and the Billing group with the fee schedules page (fee items, schedules, copy from year) (mis-15), and the payment plans page (installment due dates, down payment, tuition adjustment, copy from year) (mis-16), and the discount types and student discounts pages (global catalog; per-year assignments checked against stage, once per type, one government type) (mis-17), and the assessments page and printable statement of account (preview, save, re-assess with history; discount changes re-assess on confirm) (mis-18), and the cashier role with the payments page, student ledger (record payment, void with reason) and printable acknowledgment receipt (mis-19), and payment holds: the enroll modal hold check and notice, the Payment holds page, promissory notes (grant, cancel) and the ledger hold banner and notes (mis-20), and the Academics group with the subjects catalog (search, type/status filters, add/edit, deactivate/reactivate) and the per-year curriculum (grade level / strand / term groups, total weekly hours, add, remove, move up/down, copy from previous year; read-only for the cashier) (mis-21), and the teacher role (Teacher in the employee role picker/filter/chip; a teacher-only user lands on My classes and sees no school-year badge), the admin Rooms setup page (search, type/status filters, add/edit, deactivate/reactivate) and room/adviser pickers, columns and filters on Sections (mis-22), and the Class schedules page (Academics, admin + registrar: section/teacher/room modes, subject list with teacher, meetings and hours chip, class modal saving teacher + meetings as one set with per-meeting conflict errors, read-only Mon–Sat timetable grid) (mis-23), and My classes (teacher landing; admin/registrar pick a teacher: school year + term pickers, class list with schedule and student count, own week grid, advisory section block with roster, week and class links, in-page print) and the printable Class list (header, numbered roster, muted left-the-class group, guardian columns only when returned) (mis-24), and grading: subject weight groups on the Subjects form and table, the printable Class record (quarter picker, WW/PT/QA score grid with keyboard keys and live grades, save, activities, submit/lock, reopen with reason, history, landscape print), report cards (Enrollment row action, advisory roster links, school-year picker, portrait print) and the advisory section's bulk report-card print (mis-25); and the chart of accounts with the accountant role (accountant in the Employees picker/filter/chip; read-only Billing pages for the accountant; an Accounting menu group; Chart of accounts at `/accounting/chart-of-accounts` for admin + accountant, grouped by type and sorted by code, search + Type/Status filters, Add/Edit modal with the subtype list limited to the type, Deactivate/Reactivate/Delete through ConfirmDialog, server 422 errors on the fields) (mis-26); and the journal and general ledger (Journal entries list with status/date/account filters and search, routed New/Edit-draft form with an editable debit/credit line grid, live totals and Post behind a confirm, routed detail with Edit/Delete on drafts and a Reverse modal on posted entries, General ledger per account with opening, running balance and closing; Accounting menu items for admin + accountant; the account form locks code and type once the account is in use) (mis-27); and the auto-posting screens (Posting settings page at /accounting/posting-settings with one account picker per purpose grouped as the server sends them, changed-only save with per-purpose errors, an unposted-events panel with Post pending behind a confirm and a posted/failed summary; journal screens gain a Source badge and filter, a source link to the statement of account or receipt, and no Edit/Delete/Reverse for billing entries) (mis-28); and the financial reports (printable Trial balance, Income statement, Balance sheet and AR aging at /accounting/* for admin + accountant, each with date/filters, Print and a client-side CSV download; Balanced / Out of balance chips, net loss in parentheses and red, an AR aging tie-out panel linking to Posting settings and row links to the student ledger; trial balance codes open General ledger prefilled from the route query) (mis-29); next is the RFID card-assignment flow rebuilt from `enrollment-fe` (same UX, fixed defects).

## Ownership

Owner: a.baladon@qstrike.com. Part of the `mis` project — shared plans, rules and wiki live in the workspace and are linked here at `.claude/common/` and `.claude/diagrams/`.

## Local Contracts

- Stack: javascript / Vue ^3.5.42 + Vite ^8.3, Pinia, vue-router, axios, Tailwind 4, laravel-echo + pusher-js, icons `@lucide/vue`, font `@fontsource-variable/manrope` ("Manrope Variable") · DB: none (all data from mis-backend)
- Layer chain (build order): api-service → store? → component → view → route → layout? · pure helpers in `src/utils/` sit outside the chain (no Vue, no HTTP) and are unit-tested with Vitest
- Coding rules: `.claude/rules/rules-common.md`, `.claude/rules/rules-frontend.md`. Both are binding.
- Implementation agent: `fe-developer`. Auditor: `fe-auditor`.
- Plans for this repo: `.claude/common/plans/active/<slug>/plan-fe.md`

Realtime contract (with mis-backend): Echo `broadcaster: 'pusher'`, config only from `VITE_PUSHER_*`; public channel `rfid`, event `AssignRfid`, UID in `e.message`. Assignment flow: `POST /rfid/open` → listen → `PUT /students/rfid/{id}` `{rfid}` → `POST /rfid/close` when the modal closes; leave the channel on unmount.

## Work Guidance

- Run: `npm run dev` · Test: `npm test` (Vitest 5.0.5, `vitest run`, node environment, `src/**/*.test.js`) · Lint: none installed (automated checks: `npm test` and `npm run build`)
- Ports: 5173 (dev); mis-backend on 8000
- Requires Node 20.19+ or 22.12+ (Vite 8). On Node 20.18 `npm run build` fails.
- Install with `npm install` (`.npmrc` keeps `legacy-peer-deps=true`); `cp .env.example .env`. Never read or commit `.env`.
- Conventions: `<script setup>` SFCs; `@/` imports; HTTP only via `src/services/` on `http.js`; services return `response.data` and let errors reject with the server message; Tailwind only (no Vuetify); toasts via `vue-toastification` with a loading state per async call; no `console.*`; no hardcoded URLs or Pusher keys.
- Auth (mis-1): Sanctum token handling lives in `http.js` interceptors, user/role state in `authStore.js`, role checks in the `router.js` guard. New guarded pages go as children of the `MainPanelLayout` route with their own `meta.title`, a route-name constant in `src/routeNames.js`, a `ROUTE_ROLES` entry in `src/routeRoles.js` (the single page-roles source, read by `router.js` `meta.roles` and `navConfig.js`; never a role list in either file), and (if in the menu) a `NAV_ITEMS` entry in `src/layout/sidebar/navConfig.js`.
- Ledger style (mis-2): colors from the `@theme` tokens in `src/style.css`, font "Manrope Variable" via `@fontsource-variable/manrope`, icons from `@lucide/vue` only.

## Verification

- `npm run build` passes (Node ≥ 20.19); changed pages checked by hand in `npm run dev` against a running mis-backend (and Pusher for the RFID flow)
- `npm test` passes (Vitest)
- `fe-auditor` passes on staged changes before commit

None yet. Add a child AGENTS.md when a folder (e.g. `src/services/`) becomes a durable boundary.

# DOX framework

AGENTS.md files are binding work contracts for their subtrees. Before editing, read this file plus every AGENTS.md on the path to each file you'll touch; the nearest one is the local contract. After a meaningful change, update the closest owning AGENTS.md if purpose, structure, contracts, routes, entities, or workflows changed, and remove stale text. Create a child AGENTS.md when a folder becomes a durable boundary. Child sections: Purpose · Ownership · Local Contracts · Work Guidance · Verification · Child DOX Index.
